title: Connector Pulse
description: A bold connector story that receives a message, routes it through one workflow, and returns the result across team channels.

source.name: iPolloWork HyperFrames
source.attribution: Original iPolloWork composition adapted from HyperFrames radial-network and message-motion patterns.

applyChecklist: Replace the trigger, response, and channel labels with the actual connected workflow.
Keep every channel logo-neutral unless approved brand assets are supplied.
Use design-system tokens for all themeable surfaces, lines, text, and states.
Verify the inbound and outbound message order remains obvious at 30 fps.
